title: Method for processing distributed data of federal learning mobile equipment based on summer pril value

pse.problem: Limited by the communication bandwidth and computing resources of the central server, in each round of federated learning, only some mobile devices can be selected to participate in the model training process, which reduces the convergence speed and final performance of the model.
pse.solution_function: The method selects mobile devices based on their contribution to the model training process using Shapley value, thereby reducing data communication overhead, increasing convergence speed, and improving model performance.
pse.solution_structure: The solution involves multiple mobile devices and a central node for federated learning. The Shapley value is used as a selection criterion for mobile devices.
pse.solution_implementation: An estimation method of federal Shapley value is proposed, which combines the traditional Monte-Carlo sampling method to measure the impact of data sets of each mobile terminal on the model training process. This allows for the selection of mobile devices with the highest contribution in each round.
pse.effect: The solution results in reduced data communication overhead, increased convergence speed, and improved model performance.
